name: Blazing Ace
source:
"I want to be stronger…"
Summer bootcamp has begun!!! Let’s make your dream come true! Beast Fella Foundation (BFF), an organization which monitors martial arts competitions among beastmen, has sent you an invitation letter. An unforgettable summer memory ensues.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367840/Blazing_Ace/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我想变得更强……”
夏日集训营开营啦！让梦想成真吧！负责监督兽人武术赛事的Beast Fella Foundation（简称BFF）向你寄来了一封邀请函。一段难忘的夏日回忆就此展开。
